exec_summary.vision_statement: A finance close process Northwind can trust to run on time every month, without a manual invoice-matching backlog.
exec_summary.narrative: Northwind's invoice-matching process is largely manual, creating a backlog during peak season. Cegeka will deliver an AI-assisted matching workflow validated against a defined test set, on a phased fixed-fee basis.
exec_summary.what_we_deliver: An AI-assisted invoice matching pilot integrated with the existing ERP.
exec_summary.how_success_measured: Matching precision on a frozen test set, and manual-effort reduction.
exec_summary.commercial_headline: Fixed fee per phase, EUR 180,000 total across Discovery, Design, and Pilot **+ pass-through Azure OpenAI costs**.

context_scope.business_context: Northwind's finance shared-service centre processes 40,000 invoices/month; roughly 30% require manual matching against purchase orders, causing month-end close delays.

objectives.text: Reduce manual invoice-matching effort by an estimated 40% via an AI-assisted workflow, validated against a defined test set.
Establish the data foundation for Northwind's 2027 finance automation roadmap.

workstreams.in_scope: Invoice/PO data inventory across 2 ERP instances; data quality profiling
workstreams.out_of_scope: Remediation of data quality issues found

workstreams.in_scope: Matching model + review UI for one business unit

assumptions: Data volumes do not exceed 50,000 invoices/month and are provided as CSV exports from the ERP.
Client provides access to named systems within 5 business days of request.
Client provides 8 hours/week of named SME time.
prerequisites: ERP read access and credentials for the named Cegeka team members.
Confirmed availability of the named finance SME.
context_scope.data_provided: Historical invoice and PO records (24 months), exported monthly as CSV from the SAP and Dynamics instances.
dependencies: Northwind's concurrent ERP consolidation project proceeding on its stated schedule.

success_metrics.definition: TP / (TP+FP) on the frozen 500-invoice test set in Appendix B
success_metrics.consumed_by: Finance Ops reviews the weekly precision dashboard to decide whether to raise the auto-post confidence threshold.

success_metrics.definition: Baseline vs. post-pilot minutes/invoice on matched subset
success_metrics.consumed_by: Shared-service centre lead uses the monthly effort report to reallocate reviewer headcount for peak season.

deliverables.name: Data & AI Readiness Assessment report
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Covers agreed dimensions in Appendix B; presented to steering committee
deliverables.acceptance_process: Client has 3 business days to review; deemed accepted if no written objection

deliverables.name: Matching pilot model + review UI
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Meets Success Metrics in Section 4 on the frozen test set
deliverables.acceptance_process: Joint review session; pass/fail recorded in Acceptance Log

acceptance.checkpoint_timing: At approximately two-thirds of elapsed pilot duration,
acceptance.checkpoint_description: the parties hold a joint checkpoint to confirm the pilot remains on track to meet the Section 4 targets; outcome (continue/adjust/stop) is recorded in writing.

phases.gate_decision: Meets Success Metrics -> proceed to scale discussion

approach.technical_description: Azure-hosted matching service using Azure OpenAI for line-item extraction and a rules+ML hybrid matcher; integrates with SAP and Dynamics via existing export jobs.
approach.governance_cadence: Bi-weekly steering committee; weekly RAG status email.

roles.cegeka_team: 1 Engagement Lead (20%), 1 Data Scientist (80%), 1 Data Engineer (50%).
client_obligations: Named business sponsor with decision authority, available within 3 business days for approvals.
Timely provisioning of data access and environments per Section 3.4.

milestone_payments.trigger: Final engagement sign-off, settled directly with the funding program administrator (not blended into the customer-paid milestones above)

commercial.payment_terms: Net 30 from invoice date, EUR. Client-paid milestones above sum to 100% of the customer-payable (net) fee; the Partner-Led Funding milestone is settled separately and is not part of the customer-payable amount.
commercial.expenses_policy: Pre-approved travel only, invoiced at cost.
commercial.pass_through_policy: Azure OpenAI consumption is pass-through, invoiced at cost + 5% handling fee, capped at EUR 1,500/month absent written pre-approval.
commercial.cofunding_program: A portion of this engagement is co-funded via Microsoft ECIF, referred to throughout this SOW as Partner-Led Funding.
commercial.invoicing_address: Northwind Retail Group B.V., Finance Dept, Amsterdam

term.end_condition: final deliverable acceptance under this SOW
term.transition_assistance: Handover documentation included; no additional fee if requested within 30 days of termination.

ip.model_artifacts_ownership: The fine-tuned matching model and prompts created specifically for Client are licensed to Client for use with the deliverable; the underlying foundation model remains the property of its vendor.

data_protection.processor_role: Cegeka acts as Processor on Client's behalf under the DPA referenced in the MSA.
subprocessors: Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service (EU data boundary)

regulatory.ai_risk_classification: To be jointly determined during Discovery.
regulatory.human_oversight: All matches below 0.9 confidence are routed to human review before posting.
regulatory.bias_fairness_testing: Out of scope for this pilot; matching model operates on transactional data only.
